Water from natural sources may contain substances such as metal compounds, dissolved oxygen,
phosphates and plastics.
Which statement is correct?
A
Some metal compounds provide essential minerals for life.
B
Dissolved oxygen is always harmful to aquatic life.
C
Phosphates increase the oxygenation of the water.
D
Most plastics break down into harmless substances in water.

options.label: A
options.text: Some metal compounds provide essential minerals for life.

options.label: B
options.text: Dissolved oxygen is always harmful to aquatic life.

options.label: C
options.text: Phosphates increase the oxygenation of the water.

options.label: D
options.text: Most plastics break down into harmless substances in water.
